races.name: Sky Bet Mile Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
races.verdict:
The 3-y-o handicap over this trip at Glorious Goodwood looks the key piece of form here. Runner-up ZENNOR STORM was one of several who shaped better than the result and is taken to go one place better this time. Intense Vision and Storming Point are others who very much caught the eye in that Goodwood contest and head the dangers along with Britannia runner-up Outback Heat and Le Samourai, who has snuck in at the bottom of the weights and also bagged the inside stall.

  1. ZENNOR STORM
  2. INTENSE VISION
  3. STORMING POINT

races.name: Weatherbys Lonsdale Cup Stakes (Group 2)
races.verdict:
AMILOC didn't get the opportunity to show what he could do over 2m in the Goodwood Cup and has to be worth another chance to show he can make a big splash in the staying ranks. Caballo de Mar has a Group 1 penalty but is still feared most ahead of Carmers.

  1. AMILOC
  2. CABALLO DE MAR (IRE)
  3. CARMERS (IRE)

races.name: Al Basti Equiworld Dubai Gimcrack Stakes (Group 2)
races.verdict:
The exciting ARAPAHO GOLD is taken to stretch his unbeaten record to 4 and consign Adaay of Scarlett, who has cheekpieces added this afternoon, to yet another second-place finish at Group 2 level. Marco Polo is interesting quickly stepped up in grade.

  1. ARAPAHO GOLD (IRE)
  2. ADAAY OF SCARLETT (IRE)
  3. MARCO POLO (IRE)

races.name: Coolmore City Of Troy Nunthorpe Stakes (Group 1)
races.verdict:
BACIO was most impressive at Royal Ascot and has the potential to dominate a European 5f scene that has been thin for a number of years. Rayevka has improved for the drop back to 5f and has the form to go close, as does American Affair, who looked back to his very best when winning the King George Stakes at Glorious Goodwood.

  1. BACIO (USA)
  2. RAYEVKA (IRE)
  3. AMERICAN AFFAIR

races.name: Assured Data Protection Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
This is wide open but it could pay to side with FRENCH DUKE who hasn't been seen to best effect on his last 2 runs at Ascot and Southwell and has slipped to a handy-looking mark for his in-form handler. Master Vintner showed the benefit of blinkers when going in at Thirsk last time and rates a big threat with likely more to offer, while the consistent Tycoon can also play a prominent role with Ryan Moore in the saddle. The Irish-trained duo Truth Be Told and Zanndabad complete the shortlist.

  1. FRENCH DUKE (IRE)
  2. MASTER VINTNER (IRE)
  3. TYCOON

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Convivial Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
LANCASTER TOWER was notably strong in the market when shaping with plenty of encouragement behind a subsequent listed winner on debut. He looks sure to progress from that and is fancied to land this valuable maiden en route to better things. Launch Sequence is feared most following his third in a strong Glorious Goodwood maiden, while Oklahoma commands plenty of respect for an Aidan O'Brien stable bidding to win this race for a third time in 4 years.

  1. LANCASTER TOWER
  2. LAUNCH SEQUENCE (IRE)
  3. OKLAHOMA (USA)

races.name: Sky Bet EBF Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
SILVER LAKE has proved a different proposition since fitted with a tongue strap in handicaps over this sort of trip, decisively supplementing her breakthrough Salisbury victory at Goodwood 3 weeks ago. She looks a major player again in her hat-trick bid despite a 9 lb higher mark. Food For Thought and Lady Dora Mae have chased home the selection on each of their last 2 starts respectively and head the dangers, along with Dream Camp and Plaid.

  1. SILVER LAKE
  2. FOOD FOR THOUGHT
  3. LADY DORA MAE (IRE)

races.name: Racing Welfare Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BEGUILED shaped with plenty of encouragement when faring best of the newcomers in a maiden at Glorious Goodwood and she can put that experience to use up against some interesting newcomers, including Andrew Balding's Show Me Glory.

  1. BEGUILED
  2. SHOW ME GLORY (IRE)
  3. LATE NIGHT SHOW

races.name: British EBF Novice Stakes
races.verdict:
MAJESTIC JUDE might have gone close had he proved more clued up in a Yarmouth novice that is working out well so he earns the vote over Charlie Appleby's debutant Al Jabbar.

  1. MAJESTIC JUDE (IRE)
  2. AL JABBAR (IRE)
  3. ASTABUEN (FR)

races.name: Racing TV Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
SHALLOW needs to dispel a lesser effort at Goodwood on her most recent start 24 days ago but she'd previously gone close on each of her last 2 visits to this C&D and could be worth chancing to bounce back. Zighy and 3-time C&D winner Angel Shared are others to consider in what is a competitive heat.

  1. SHALLOW
  2. ZIGHY (IRE)
  3. ANGEL SHARED

races.name: Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict:
FANCIULLA DEL WEST needs to shrug off a lesser effort at Newbury when last seen 50 days ago but she'd previously highlighted this sort of mark is an exploitable one when second at Redcar in May and is afforded another chance to get back on the up. Jim & Suzi Best's recent acquisition Liberate is another to note, with Emma's Letter completing the shortlist.

  1. FANCIULLA DEL WEST
  2. LIBERATE
  3. EMMA'S LETTER

races.name: End Of Summer Season Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
RIZAL is thriving for George Scott and gets a confident vote to defy a 5 lb rise for his stylish Hamilton victory and complete a hat-trick. The consistent Patrol appeals as the one to chase him home ahead of the lightly-raced Zurna.

  1. RIZAL (FR)
  2. PATROL (IRE)
  3. ZURNA

races.name: See You On The Rowley Mile Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
A case can be made for a few of these but the verdict goes to GHISA who is better than her recent form figures suggest and can now capitalise on a lenient-looking mark. Both Too Too Divine (second choice) and Miss Gallant appeal as likely improvers now going handicapping and can play a prominent role too, while the reliable Hilltop also needs factoring in.

  1. GHISA (IRE)
  2. TOO TOO DIVINE (IRE)
  3. MISS GALLANT

races.name: Taste The World Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
DARVEL won this race last year and comes here in consistent form. He therefore looks sure to give his running and that could prove good enough to get the better of Thiscouldbefun, who looks obviously well treated having escaped a penalty for a recent course success but did have the run of things that day, while Kimeko Glory and Prince Rasam could be threats, too.

  1. DARVEL (IRE)
  2. THISCOULDBEFUN (IRE)
  3. KIMEKO GLORY

races.name: Robert Gilbert Birthday Celebration Irish EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SPIRIT OF LYRA showed major progress to run out an impressive winner at Lingfield last time and, with the newcomers hard to weigh up, she looks to have an excellent chance of following up at the expense of a couple that have experience under their belts, namely Thanks Harry and Chan Noir.

  1. SPIRIT OF LYRA (IRE)
  2. THANKS HARRY
  3. CHAN NOIR

races.name: Andy Hardwick & Clive Leonard Memorial Handicap
races.verdict:
KOHANA NATION made it third time lucky on return/turf debut at Doncaster and with further progress on the cards now handicapping, Charlie Hills' colt can follow up at the expense of Bintola, who made a solid start in handicaps back in the spring but needs to leave a lesser effort behind. Zen Diva can edge out Coyy for minor honours.

  1. KOHANA NATION (IRE)
  2. BINTOLA
  3. ZEN DIVA

races.name: Cara Glass Handicap
races.verdict:
VIOLET GOLDSMITH took her form up a notch when getting off the mark at Chepstow 7 weeks ago with the runner-up that day having gone in since, Eve Johnson Houghton's filly is fancied to make light of a 3 lb rise. Her main threat may emerge from Box Clever, who recaptured her best form at Windsor last time and a repeat puts her well in the mix. Crimson Sunset rounds off the shortlist with any rain only enhancing her chance.

  1. VIOLET GOLDSMITH
  2. BOX CLEVER
  3. CRIMSON SUNSET

races.name: Signs In Motion British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BINTWARD looks head and shoulders above her opposition here on the basis of her debut Wolverhampton success. Golden Island can follow her home.

  1. BINTWARD
  2. GOLDEN ISLAND (IRE)
  3. HERSTMONCEUX

races.name: Edwards Ford, Foray Motor Group Handicap
races.verdict:
A DAUGHTERS LOVE has been a real success story for David Flood this season and can win for the fourth time in the campaign. Basilette doesn't always find as much as she promises but has been in good form over hurdles and is also shortlisted alongside Panthere Noir, who has been running well in classified company.

  1. A DAUGHTERS LOVE
  2. BASILETTE (IRE)
  3. PANTHERE NOIR

races.name: Ascona Ladies Fuelled By Fashion Handicap
races.verdict:
SIXTYGEESBABY took advantage of a much-reduced mark in the style of one that could climb back up the handicapping ranks at Carlisle recently, so he's a confident selection to follow up under a 5 lb penalty. Pull The Rug looked unlucky not to win Chepstow on his most recent outing and is feared most.

  1. SIXTYGEESBABY (IRE)
  2. PULL THE RUG (IRE)
  3. SAFARI DREAM (IRE)

races.name: Ascona Ladies Chic Fashion Handicap
races.verdict:
OVIEDO retains plenty of handicapping scope on old form and will surely prove hard to beat under a 5 lb penalty if turning up here in similar form to his wide-margin win the previous week. Last year's winner Cypriot Diaspora turned in her best effort of the season over C&D on her most recent outing and is feared most ahead of last-time-out scorer Kaleidoscope Eyes.

  1. OVIEDO (IRE)
  2. CYPRIOT DIASPORA
  3. KALEIDOSCOPE EYES (IRE)

races.name: Ascona Ladies In Lace Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This can go to KORBUT, who upped her game when second on handicap debut at Southwell last month. She sets the standard on that form. Potential improver Reader is the forecast pick.

  1. KORBUT
  2. READER
  3. LIKENESS (IRE)

races.name: Ascona Ladies Fashion And Style Handicap
races.verdict:
WILLOWINGHURN has been cut plenty of slack by the handicapper and there were positive signs at Beverley last week. She could be the answer here. Diamond Ali and Cougar Force rate the principal dangers.

  1. WILLOWINGHURN
  2. DIAMOND ALI
  3. COUGAR FORCE

races.name: Ascona Fabulous Ladies Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
GERT LUSH arrives in good form and wasn't seen to best effect at Lingfield earlier this month. She gets the nod. Lapidarist and Charencey may provide the chief threat.

  1. GERT LUSH (IRE)
  2. LAPIDARIST
  3. CHARENCEY (IRE)

races.name: Ascona Ladies Race Day Elegance Handicap
races.verdict:
ATALANTA MIST fared best of those held up when third at Chepstow and she can now be ridden a bit more positively having proved her stamina over this far. Fellow 3-y-o filly Dream of Ithaca took a step forward when off the mark in a classified event at Brighton 2 weeks ago and is second choice ahead of Buck Barrow and Saxophonic.

  1. ATALANTA MIST
  2. DREAM OF ITHACA
  3. BUCK BARROW

races.name: Why Settle Technology AI Adoption EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
It'll be a turn-up for the books if PIKACHU doesn't open his account at the fifth attempt. Trumpety Trump may achieve a hollow second-place finish.

  1. PIKACHU
  2. TRUMPETY TRUMP (IRE)
  3. NICE NEASY DOES IT

races.name: Huws Gray British Stallions EBF Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
William Haggas has a 43% strike rate in handicaps at this course and having landed last year's corresponding event with an unexposed 3-y-o, his WILD DAHLIA is fancied to follow suit. In-form Polygram and thriving Saxon Grace appeal most of the remainder.

  1. WILD DAHLIA
  2. POLYGRAM
  3. SAXON GRACE (IRE)

races.name: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
LORD D'OR has been runner-up on his last 3 starts, most recently bumping into a promising Godolphin-owned newcomer at Windsor, so he's fancied to go one better with this step up in trip sure to suit. Nakassama won over hurdles in June and has bags of experience so could capitalise if the selection flops.

  1. LORD D'OR (GER)
  2. NAKASSAMA (IRE)
  3. FLAGBEARER

races.name: Scullion Law Lanark Silver Bell Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
YABHER hails from a top yard and can make amends for his luckless Goodwood effort 24 days ago, where he was denied a run and badly hampered in the final 1f. The step back up in trip should suit and he's preferred to Tiernan, who won a novice here 20 days ago and should prove suited by this longer trip. Salamanca City is thriving and could make an impact upped in grade.

  1. YABHER
  2. TIERNAN (IRE)
  3. SALAMANCA CITY (IRE)

races.name: Acrisure Handicap
races.verdict:
A trappy sprint in which preference is for ETERNAL SUNSHINE, who got back to her very best when just denied over C&D recently and Jim Goldie's mare looks ready to open her account for the season. Vantheman deserves credit for his consistency, so he could emerge as the biggest threat, with the selection's stablemate Jordan Electrics rounding off the shortlist.

  1. ETERNAL SUNSHINE
  2. VANTHEMAN (IRE)
  3. JORDAN ELECTRICS

races.name: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
SIR GARFIELD went within a flared nostril of notching his third success of the year at Epsom last week so, provided this doesn't come too soon, John & Sean Quinn's 5-y-o gets the nod to make amends. Lipsink ran a cracker when second on return at Sandown 10 weeks ago and he looks set for another big run, with Abduction and Wreck It Ryley another couple of runners fancied to be in the shake-up, too.

  1. SIR GARFIELD (IRE)
  2. LIPSINK (IRE)
  3. ABDUCTION (FR)

races.name: Patersons Of Greenoakhill Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
DANDY MAGIC has struck up a rapport with the good-value claimer Lauren Young and she can defy a penalty to notch back-to-back C&D success. City Captain has been absent for a few months but his form in the spring would give him a major shout here, with Miraculous also respected on the back of a recent all-weather success.

  1. DANDY MAGIC (IRE)
  2. CITY CAPTAIN
  3. MIRACULOUS (IRE)

races.name: Hemmings Homes 10th Anniversary Handicap
races.verdict:
TANJEN put an easy lead to good use at C&D last week and is technically 6 lb "well in" without a penalty, so makes obvious appeal as she bids to follow up. The hat-trick seeking King of The Jungle is highly respected after a 9-week break, with Startling also a player after several good efforts in defeat.

  1. TANJEN (IRE)
  2. KING OF THE JUNGLE (IRE)
  3. STARTLING

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
SEAXBURH has been crying out for at least 1m for some time and is taken to make an immediate impact on nursery debut. Margot Mae’s standout maiden effort has been boosted since and she rates the chief threat, especially if any rain arrives, while Belicoso has seemingly been brought along with handicaps in mind and should also appreciate the step up in trip.

  1. SEAXBURH (IRE)
  2. MARGOT MAE (IRE)
  3. BELICOSO (IRE)

races.name: CSG Rated Race
races.verdict:
MANTON BAY has shaped well on each of his last 4 starts and, granted a truer pace than last time, is taken to open his account as a 3-y-o. Kirkland Sioux won consecutive handicaps at Fairyhouse and the Curragh in July and, though she didn’t fire on softer ground at Galway last time, she looks capable of bouncing back and rates the chief danger, with the progressive Iamimmaculate also respected in a first-time tongue strap.

  1. MANTON BAY (IRE)
  2. KIRKLAND SIOUX (IRE)
  3. IAMIMMACULATE (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Vincent O'Brien Ruby Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
HARDY WARRIOR boasts a progressive profile and is taken to cope with the step back up in grade in a race in which conditions look in his favour. Jagged Edge is in much better form than his most recent effort suggests and can make his presence felt, while Carolina Jetstream looks capable of getting back on track returned to calmer waters.

  1. HARDY WARRIOR (IRE)
  2. JAGGED EDGE (IRE)
  3. CAROLINA JETSTREAM

races.name: T1 Healthcare Handicap
races.verdict:
SWEET BABY ZOU would probably have resumed her progression granted a clearer run at Galway last time and is taken to gain compensation here. Chirac lacked a change of gear last time, but he had won over 7f and finished runner-up over this trip at Cork prior to that, so he rates the chief danger. Casamorati left previous efforts well behind when a close second at Galway 21 days ago and is respected despite a 4 lb rise.

  1. SWEET BABY ZOU
  2. CHIRAC (IRE)
  3. CASAMORATI (IRE)

races.name: Kellihers Toyota Kingdom Gold Cup Handicap (Premier Handicap)
races.verdict:
EAGLE FANG and Immutable both arrive on the back of excellent placed efforts in Premier Handicaps at Galway so they top the shortlist, in that order. Luker's Tipple is potentially on a good mark back in this sphere after his recent exploits over jumps so he's another to consider.

  1. EAGLE FANG (IRE)
  2. IMMUTABLE (IRE)
  3. LUKER'S TIPPLE (IRE)

races.name: Killarney Towers Hotel & Leisure Centre Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
LADY PLIMSOLL turned in her best effort of the season when second over shorter at Roscommon 3 days ago and she looks a big player turned out quickly with her stamina for this sort of trip already confirmed. Last month's course scorer Chicago Moon, Celestially and Espritroyale are others fancied to be in the thick of things.

  1. LADY PLIMSOLL (IRE)
  2. CHICAGO MOON (IRE)
  3. CELESTIALLY (IRE)

races.name: HR Buddy (Q.R.) Race
races.verdict:
The fitness of the returning SAMUI has to be taken on trust but he is difficult to oppose in the finale. Ragmans Corner and Murat may give him most to think about.

  1. SAMUI
  2. RAGMANS CORNER (IRE)
  3. MURAT (IRE)

races.name: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle On 29th August Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
While there are some reservations about KIMI DE MAI as a betting proposition, he's still the one to beat on all known form. First Ascent and Mistakenforanother are most interesting among the remainder.

  1. KIMI DE MAI (FR)
  2. FIRST ASCENT (IRE)
  3. MISTAKENFORANOTHER (IRE)

races.name: Follow Kilbeggan On Instagram Novice Hurdle
races.verdict:
ROSIE'S WINGS holds the clear edge on form and is fancied to quickly resume winning ways on the back of an excellent Galway third. Hurdling newcomer Katie Can't Count represents Willie Mullins and could emerge as the main danger after a promising bumper fourth at Downpatrick ahead of Limerick scorer La Cote Fleurie.

  1. ROSIE'S WINGS (IRE)
  2. KATIE CAN'T COUNT (IRE)
  3. LA COTE FLEURIE (FR)

races.name: Tom Lynam Memorial Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
The addition of first-time cheekpieces may be a catalyst for DIAMOND TIPP to record a second hurdles victory. Handicap debutant Solar Generation looks interesting, especially if supported. Parkgarve, Blue Reed and Mysilverriverfeale are others to consider in a competitive event.

  1. DIAMOND TIPP (IRE)
  2. SOLAR GENERATION (IRE)
  3. PARKGARVE (IRE)

races.name: Peadar's Bar Moate Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
Fifth in a Galway maiden that has already produced a couple of subsequent winners, DAD SEZ could be tough to beat second time up under Rules. Benner Wenner appeals most of the remainder.

  1. DAD SEZ (IRE)
  2. BENNER WENNER (FR)
  3. LADY FELICIA (IRE)

races.name: New Forest Estate & Golf Club Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict:
FR GILLIGANSVOYGE is fancied to defy a 6 lb rise and follow up his recent Tramore success at the chief expense of One Way Traffic who comes here on the back of a very good Roscommon second. Broken Ice can also play a prominent role.

  1. FR GILLIGANSVOYGE
  2. ONE WAY TRAFFIC (IRE)
  3. BROKEN ICE (IRE)

races.name: Belvedere House & Gardens Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
CHARLIE LUCIANO wasn't seen to ideal effect when fourth in a big-field Galway handicap last time and can quickly resume winning ways off the same mark here. Koori Star could emerge as the chief threat now back chasing after an encouraging ninth on his return over hurdles, although both Ira Hayes and A Wave Of The Sea also need factoring in.

  1. CHARLIE LUCIANO (IRE)
  2. KOORI STAR (IRE)
  3. IRA HAYES (IRE)

races.name: John Thomas McNamara Series Flat Race
races.verdict:
An ordinary-looking bumper with a chance taken on BELLAHILL, who finished third on his only outing in points and has joined a yard more than capable of readying one in this sphere. Baymount had the benefit of an enterprising ride when third at Wexford a fortnight ago but still leads the way on form ahead of Hill Silver. In Around Thehouse is another Rules newcomer to monitor closely in the betting.

  1. BELLAHILL
  2. BAYMOUNT (IRE)
  3. HILL SILVER (IRE)
